title: Retail Store Interior Design 50 m² | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: 50 m² retail store: interior design, 3D visualization and custom furniture. DUMSKAYA DESIGN, Bratislava and Vienna.
h1: Store interior design and custom furniture, 50 m²

blocks.text: Store interior design and custom furniture, 50 m²

parts.html: A 50 m² shop selling manicure tools and equipment. The studio created the interior design project with 3D visualization and made custom retail furniture for the shop.

The small floor area had to hold the merchandise, customers and staff comfortably while keeping the shop’s look consistent. The furniture was designed around the size of the room, the way goods are displayed and stored, and the company’s brand style: deep blue, black metal and wood.

blocks.text: How the shop floor is laid out

parts.html: The room runs along a shop window with floor-to-ceiling glazing. By the entrance stands the checkout counter with a blue countertop and the shop’s name on the front panel; the visualizations show two finish options for it. Behind the counter is a wall-to-wall wooden shelving unit for boxed lamps and devices, with closed cabinets at the bottom.

Along the side wall there are modules on a black metal frame. In one of them a perforated sheet replaces the back panel, and nippers, scissors and files hang on hooks on it, so customers can see the whole range at once. Next to it are open shelves with linear lighting and closed cabinets below for stock. A long black console runs along the window for displaying samples.

One wall is finished in vertical wood slats and has two white sculptures of hands on it. In front of it is a high table with bar stools where customers can wait or look through products. The wall behind the shelving was clad in white 3D panels with a round relief. The lower part of the other walls is dark gray panels with horizontal joints, and the upper part is painted light gray.

Round hanging planters with greenery and an LED ring underneath hang above the shop floor, giving both plants and soft light. Above the shelving, the ceiling is closed off with a black grid with spotlights. The floor is light wood-look tile. More of the studio’s work for businesses is on the commercial interiors page.
